name: B10-0408/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Second World Summit for Social Development
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position ahead of a United Nations summit on social development. It asks the European Union and its member states to do more to fight poverty and social exclusion, create quality jobs, protect workers' rights and make the green transition fair. It also calls for action on child poverty, housing, minimum income, education and training, and for the EU to support social development in poorer countries. The text is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a set of political demands to the EU Commission and member states.
- **Who it affects:** People at risk of poverty, workers, children, and vulnerable groups across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends its position to the EU Council and Commission, which decide whether to act.
